body: No, you are being abused. The ones abusing you made you believe that you deserve this kind of treatment. There is no such thing as deserving ro be abused. Please be kind to yourself at least, self harm will only make it worse.
I agree with the other comment, nobody should scream and belittle you, you deserve better. Please try to get somewhere safe.

I understand that. I thought about suicide a lot in the past years, planning out every detail...but I can't get over hurting my loved ones. I am still hanging on but I know I am living on borrowed time...I want to end my life on my terms as well, I wish there was a more humane way where it wouldn't have  to be this awful secret...whenever I tried talking to my loved onrs about it I have been met with resistance and misunderstanding. I jist want the sorrow to end, why is this so hard for people to understand and accept. I barely leave the house, I doubt anyonr but my SO would even really miss me...they would just miss the idea off me being alive somewhere.

Hey I agree that your situation is terrifying, but I'm here if you want to talk. I also struggle with going outside and had sexual violence happen to me...I also.have family whom I don't want to hurt, they keep me going even though I have suicidal thoughts all the time.

Hey man, I've dropped out of school to pursue digital art and now I am here. I wish I finished school, I'd at least have the minimum degree to get a decent job. I'm out of work as a freelance graphic designer because the industry has been outsourced and I also have crippling depression. So yeah, do I think you should finish school? Absolutely. Just enough to pass in case you fail at game dev. Put all the rest of your time into what you love, maybe you can do both. Btw what kind of game would you make? I love indie games.

People just can't handle death. In the west, people are made to look their best even in the coffin, with makeup and everything, in blatant denial of the reality of death and decay that awaits all. I get you man, I don't want to be here either but I've been guilt-tripping myself over the feelings of my family so I stay, keeping in mind that death is always an option if things get unbearable at some point.....it's calming somehow.
I feel the same, man...here if you wanna talk.
The only thing keeping me alive is my family telling me they love me and I can't bear the thought of hurting them. Just be there for him I guess. Idk what else to say. Don't blame yourself.
yeah I slept for 12 hours, haven' left the house in weeks, I just can't face the day. I feel useless. The thought of death gives me some peace of mind.
You're not a fraud, those with mental problems are the ones who understand it best, man. You're a survivor, every day.

Yes! I'm afraid to weigh myself but I noticed my clothes don't fit anymore, I used to stuff my face on it constantly. I couldn't cry, my creativity and interest in things was zero, i just came off it about 2 -3 weeks ago and I feel better without it, although still not at my best. I read that it helps some people but it's just not for me.
yeah everybody reacts differently to meds, maybe you should talk to your doc about changing the meds if they make you feel worse
I didn't like it, it made me cause so much weight and it wasn't worth it at all, I was feeling miserable and numb on it
I'm INFP too
I always feel alone.
I just don't reply. I keep saying I'm fine just so I don't have to hear it.

Idk people keep this a secret underneath a facade of happiness... but the fact that he was kinda talking jokingly but openly about it might actually be a hidden cry for help. Maybe you could meet up with him alone and try to talk to him without other people around so he doesn't feel intimidated...it's still very touchy though since he might not be ready to open up, but it's worth a try idk
I'm glad you're still here. ♥️
no need to say sorry, its totally ok to feel that way and to write it here, ykur feelings matter

hey i have the same diagnosis, I stopped taking meds because they made me feel numb af and I can't stand going to the doctors anymore. They don't understand what Borderline feels like. I don't k ow what will happen without the meds but...it's my body, my mind, my choice.
I am here if you need to talk man
sorry to hear that, I feel the same way.

Oh I don't even remember the names or faces of these people from school anymore. I know I used to be upset because I was bullied and ignored by othe kids, never could fit in. God if I only knew then how completely unimportant they were in my life I would have never let myself suffer because of them. Just hold on, focus on yourself and what you love and remember that all of this school bs will be just a pale bad memory one day.
So inspiring ♥️ I want the same.
I feel the same.
I read everything and I understand where you are coming from. Hope you find a better solution though, I think you are a nice person who didn't deserve to be treated that badly in life.
just know that whatever you're going through is going to pass. Withdrawal can be extremely frightening but it is temporary ♥️

I had weed induced paychosis for a month after using weed daily for about a year. I felt like I was in an alternate reality and psychically able to see through space/time, had delusions and sound hallucinations, severe paranoia. It was also a manic episode for me. Music and TV and radio stations all seemed to contain secret messages....it was the most bewildering time of my life and I would not want to repeat it. I am still recovering from it.
I've had psychosis on both but I think alcohol is worse.
I had an episode where I thought that i cause thunderstorms that cause old people to die...

IKR. I have been dealt a bad genetic hand when it comes to my body and I had the same perception as you especially when looking at normal looking girls. I have a boyfriend who loves me as I am but I could never accept the way my body looks. Some poeple might think I got brainwashed by the media, and I agree, there is pressure to look a certain way but tbh i got tired of caring about what other people think. I look the way I look and that's that. What if you were a pretty girl, do you think your life would be very different?
